form.title: Add Flight
form.lookupHint: We'll automatically fill in all flight details!
form.dateImproves: Tip: Adding a date improves search accuracy.
form.estimatedTimesHistorical: Based on {{count}} {{count, plural, one {historical flight} other {historical flights}}} of this route.
form.estimatedTimesCalculated: Departure and arrival times were calculated from your previous flights.
form.estimatedTimesAutomatic: Automatically estimated based on boarding time and flight distance.
form.estimatedTimesAssumption: Assumption: Departure = Boarding + 30min, flight duration -> {{minutes}} minutes.
form.reviewTimes: Please review and correct the times if necessary.

help.departureAirport: Select the departure airport. You can search by IATA code (e.g. FRA) or name.
help.arrivalAirport: Select the destination airport. You can search by IATA code (e.g. LHR) or name.
help.departureTime: Enter the departure time (local time of the departure airport).
help.departureTimeExpanded: The time should be specified in the local timezone of the departure airport. The system automatically converts if necessary.
help.arrivalTime: Enter the arrival time (local time of the arrival airport).
help.arrivalTimeExpanded: The time should be specified in the local timezone of the arrival airport. The system automatically converts if necessary.
help.price: The price is saved together with the currency. You can filter by prices later and display statistics.
help.tags: Add tags to categorize and filter flights later (e.g. 'business', 'international').
help.tagsExpanded: Tags are separated by commas. You can filter by tags later and group statistics by tags. Examples: 'business', 'vacation', 'lufthansa', 'long-haul'.
help.flightNumber: Enter the flight number (e.g. LH400). With the lookup button you can automatically retrieve flight data if an API key is configured.
help.flightNumberExpanded: The automatic flight search uses external APIs (AirLabs, AviationStack, OpenSky) to retrieve flight data. Without an API key, you must enter the data manually.
